sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日时事通讯 DealBook 的商业与政策记者。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场采访商业、政治和文化领域一些举足轻重的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的实时对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你不会想错过它的。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm not Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我不是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: He's on paternity leave.
sentences.zh: 他正在休陪产假。

sentences.en: I'm Kevin Roos.
sentences.zh: 我是凯文·罗斯。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: A Los Angeles court may soon rule on whether Britney Spears should continue to live under a controversial legal arrangement
sentences.zh: 洛杉矶一家法院可能很快就会对布兰妮·斯皮尔斯是否应该继续生活在一种备受争议的法律安排下做出裁决

sentences.en: that has given her father nearly total control of her life.
sentences.zh: 这种安排赋予了她父亲对她生活近乎完全的控制权。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Liz Day on new details about how invasive that arrangement actually was and why so few people knew the full story.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事莉兹·戴将带来关于该安排实际上有多么侵入性以及为什么很少有人知道完整故事的最新细节。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, September 29th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月29日，星期三。

sentences.en: Liz, you've been our in-house Britney Spears expert for a few years now, and you've done a ton of amazing reporting.
sentences.zh: 莉兹，你担任我们内部的布兰妮·斯皮尔斯专家已经有好几年了，而且你做了大量出色的报道。

sentences.en: And part of what I've learned from you is that Britney Spears, this, like, very famous person that I grew up listening to,
sentences.zh: 我从你那里学到的一部分是，布兰妮·斯皮尔斯，这个我从小听着她歌长大的超级大明星，

sentences.en: has actually sort of had a very mysterious period in her life.
sentences.zh: 其实她的生活中有一段非常神秘的时期。

sentences.en: Like, we just didn't hear that much from her except these, like, occasional cryptic Instagram posts.
sentences.zh: 就像我们几乎听不到她的消息，除了这些偶尔神秘的 Instagram 动态。

sentences.en: But now it seems like we're starting to get some answers.
sentences.zh: 但现在看起来我们开始得到一些答案了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, it's been really hard to understand what's been going on behind the scenes with Britney Spears.
sentences.zh: 所以，要理解布兰妮·斯皮尔斯幕后发生了什么真的很难。

sentences.en: On one level, she's one of the biggest celebrities on the planet, and she's out there making millions of dollars, performing, selling perfumes, appearing on television.
sentences.zh: 一方面，她是这个星球上最大的名人之一，她在外面赚取数百万美元，进行表演、销售香水、出现在电视上。

sentences.en: But at the same time, her life is very, very guarded because she's in something called a conservatorship.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，她的生活受到非常非常严密的保护，因为她身处一种叫做成年监护的制度中。

sentences.en: And just remind us, what is a conservatorship and how did she end up in one?
sentences.zh: 提醒一下，什么是成年监护，她是怎么陷入这种境地的？

sentences.en: So, a conservatorship is a unique, very extreme legal arrangement in which someone has their decision-making powers taken away from them.
sentences.zh: 成年监护是一种独特且极端的法律安排，在这种安排下，某人的决策权被剥夺了。

sentences.en: And instead, the court allows someone else, a conservator, to make most of your basic life decisions for you.
sentences.zh: 相反，法院允许其他人（即监护人）为您做出大部分基本的生活决定。

sentences.en: And back in 2008, Britney had been going through some public struggles that were playing out, and there were concerns around her mental health or potential substance use.
sentences.zh: 早在2008年，布兰妮经历了一些公开的挣扎，并且人们对她的心理健康或潜在的药物使用存在担忧。

sentences.en: And her father applied for a conservatorship over her.
sentences.zh: 她的父亲申请对她进行成年监护。

sentences.en: And so, she's been in that arrangement for now 13 years, and her father has been essentially in charge of her life since then?
sentences.zh: 所以她现在已经处于这种安排中13年了，她的父亲从那时起基本上就掌控了她的生活？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And from the outside, the perception was that all was well, and everything was okay.
sentences.zh: 从外部来看，给人的印象是一切都很好，一切都正常。

sentences.en: But there were a lot of rumors and speculation that Britney can't drive.
sentences.zh: 但有很多谣言和猜测说布兰妮不能开车。

sentences.en: Britney can't have a phone.
sentences.zh: 布兰妮不能拥有手机。

sentences.en: Britney's very unhappy with the situation.
sentences.zh: 布兰妮对现状很不满。

sentences.en: But it was really hard to actually know that on the record and prove that.
sentences.zh: 但要在记录上真正了解这一点并证明这一点真的很难。

sentences.en: Britney herself didn't really ever talk about the conservatorship publicly.
sentences.zh: 布兰妮本人其实从未公开谈论过成年监护。

sentences.en: But a few months ago, my reporting partner, Samantha Stark, and I were connected to someone who said he really knew what was going on behind the scenes.
sentences.zh: 但几个月前，我的报道搭档萨曼莎·斯塔克和我联系上了一个人，他说他非常清楚幕后发生了什么。

sentences.en: His name was Alex Vlasov.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫亚历克斯·瓦拉索夫。

sentences.en: And who is Alex Vlasov?
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯·瓦拉索夫是谁？

sentences.en: So, Alex is a former employee at a company called Black Box Security.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯是黑盒安全公司的一名前员工。

sentences.en: And they were the company that ran security for Britney for the last 13 years of the conservatorship.
sentences.zh: 在成年监护的最后13年里，他们是负责布兰妮安保的公司。

sentences.en: So, let's start at the beginning.
sentences.zh: 让我们从头开始。

sentences.en: So, when I got the job, I was super excited.
sentences.zh: 当我得到这份工作时，我超级兴奋。

sentences.en: It was honestly, it felt like an opportunity of a lifetime because there was potential.
sentences.zh: 老实说，这感觉就像是一生只有一次的机会，因为这里有潜力。

sentences.en: He was really excited by the opportunity to learn about the security industry.
sentences.zh: 他对有机会了解安保行业感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: He eventually dropped out of college to stay on with the company and really just master the industry.
sentences.zh: 他最终从大学辍学，留在公司，真正地精通这个行业。

sentences.en: And he started as the assistant of the founder, Adan, who was the main security guy for Britney.
sentences.zh: 他最初是创始人埃丹的助手，埃丹是布兰妮的主要安保人员。

sentences.en: I did everything from write his emails to be on all phone conversations in order to take notes for him.
sentences.zh: 我做各种事情，从写他的电子邮件到参加所有的电话会议以便为他做笔记。

sentences.en: I was the only person at Black Box that knew everything, really.
sentences.zh: 我真的是黑盒唯一一个知道所有事情的人。

sentences.en: He started growing within the company and managing the security guards and just taking on more and more responsibility.
sentences.zh: 他在公司里不断成长，管理安保警卫，并承担越来越多的责任。

sentences.en: And through that, he also started to get a really intimate glimpse into how the security apparatus worked in Britney's life.
sentences.zh: 通过这一点，他也开始对布兰妮生活中的安保机制是如何运作的有了非常深入的了解。

sentences.en: And what is this firm like?
sentences.zh: 这家公司是什么样的？

sentences.en: What services do they offer?
sentences.zh: 他们提供什么服务？

sentences.en: What kind of other clients do they have?
sentences.zh: 他们还有什么样的客户？

sentences.en: What's the deal with them?
sentences.zh: 他们是怎么回事？

sentences.en: So, Britney is the only full-time client at Black Box at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时布兰妮是黑盒唯一的全职客户。

sentences.en: And Alex says he knew nothing about what a conservatorship even was.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯说他对什么是成年监护一无所知。

sentences.en: And the only stuff he knew about it came from Adan.
sentences.zh: 他所知道的关于它的一切都来自于埃丹。

sentences.en: We were told the conservatorship was there for her own good.
sentences.zh: 我们被告知，成年监护是为了她好。

sentences.en: That it was there to protect her from influence.
sentences.zh: 它是为了保护她免受外界影响。

sentences.en: From her losing money.
sentences.zh: 免得她失去金钱。

sentences.en: That it was a way for her to have custody of her kids.
sentences.zh: 这是她获得孩子抚养权的一种方式。

sentences.en: And in some ways, what Alex observed felt normal and standard for security, for a celebrity.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，亚历克斯所观察到的对于名人的安保来说感觉很正常和标准。

sentences.en: You know, security guards would accompany Britney in public places and help keep the paparazzi away or help keep stalkers away.
sentences.zh: 你知道，安保人员会陪同布兰妮去公共场所，帮助挡开狗仔队或帮助挡开跟踪者。

sentences.en: But slowly, he started to notice red flags and things that seemed really weird to him.
sentences.zh: 但慢慢地，他开始注意到危险信号和在他看来非常奇怪的事情。

sentences.en: I remember I asked Adan, why is it that security is with her 24-7?
sentences.zh: 我记得我问过埃丹，为什么安保要24小时全天候陪着她？

sentences.en: And he told me that security was part of the conservatorship.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我安保是成年监护的一部分。

sentences.en: Why is it that Britney can't really leave the house without security and without security alerting her father and various other people about where she was going?
sentences.zh: 为什么布兰妮离开家必须有安保陪同，且安保要向她父亲以及其他各种人通报她的去向？

sentences.en: Around the same time is when one of the new agents that was working there was asking me,
sentences.zh: 大约在同一时间，一位在那里工作的新特工问我，

sentences.en: how is it okay that we're in charge of her medication?
sentences.zh: 我们负责她的药物怎么会没问题呢？

sentences.en: And he noticed that security would sometimes be in charge of giving her her medication.
sentences.zh: 他注意到安保有时会负责给她发药。

sentences.en: You know, I was like, what do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我说，你是什么意思？

sentences.en: He's like, well, we were given prepackaged envelopes.
sentences.zh: 他说，嗯，我们得到了预先包装好的信封。

sentences.en: We have to hand them to her.
sentences.zh: 我们必须把它们交给她。

sentences.en: And she can't leave.
sentences.zh: 她不能离开。

sentences.en: She has to take it there.
sentences.zh: 她必须在那里服用。

sentences.en: And, you know, every time that was brought up or discussed, it was like, this is what security should be doing because, you know, this is what the client is asking for.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，每次提出或讨论这件事时，大家都会说，安保就应该这么做，因为，你知道，这是客户要求的。

sentences.en: And this is what the client needs.
sentences.zh: 这也是客户需要的。

sentences.en: Was the client asking for it or...?
sentences.zh: 是客户要求的还是……？

sentences.en: The client is Jamie.
sentences.zh: 客户是杰米。

sentences.en: And Alex started to realize that, you know, it didn't seem as if Britney, the celebrity, was the client.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯开始意识到，你知道，看起来名人布兰妮并不是客户。

sentences.en: But instead, the client was her father, Jamie, the conservator.
sentences.zh: 相反，客户是她的父亲杰米，也就是监护人。

sentences.en: And is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: Like, is Jamie Spears the client in this case?
sentences.zh: 杰米·斯皮尔斯在这种情况下是客户吗？

sentences.en: Technically, yes.
sentences.zh: 严格来说，是的。

sentences.en: Jamie Spears is the client in this situation.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，杰米·斯皮尔斯就是客户。

sentences.en: Under the conservatorship, he is granted control of Britney's nearly $60 million fortune.
sentences.zh: 根据成年监护，他被授予了对布兰妮近6000万美元财富的控制权。

sentences.en: And even though Britney is paying the bills for everyone in this situation, including $16,000 a month for Jamie.
sentences.zh: 尽管布兰妮正在为这种情况下的每个人支付账单，包括每月给杰米的16000美元。

sentences.en: She's paying her lawyer.
sentences.zh: 她在付她的律师费。

sentences.en: She's paying for Jamie's lawyers.
sentences.zh: 她在为杰米的律师付钱。

sentences.en: She's paying for security.
sentences.zh: 她在为安保付钱。

sentences.en: She's paying for all of these people.
sentences.zh: 她在为所有这些人付钱。

sentences.en: But her father is the one in control.
sentences.zh: 但掌控一切的是她的父亲。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So as the years went on,
sentences.zh: 所以随着时间的推移，

sentences.en: Alex became more alarmed with what he was seeing.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯对所看到的事情感到更加惊慌。

sentences.en: Britney wanted to get an iPhone.
sentences.zh: 布兰妮想要一部 iPhone。

sentences.en: She saw her assistants have iPhones,
sentences.zh: 她看到她的助理有 iPhone，

sentences.en: dancers, team, Idhan even.
sentences.zh: 舞者、团队，甚至埃丹都有。

sentences.en: And she wanted an iPhone.
sentences.zh: 她想要一部 iPhone。

sentences.en: And that was a big deal.
sentences.zh: 这可是一件大事。

sentences.en: Everybody was worried.
sentences.zh: 每个人都很担心。

sentences.en: And one day, Idhan approached him and said, you know, is there any monitoring service for an iPhone that you are aware of?
sentences.zh: 有一天，埃丹找到他说，你知道，有什么你知道的针对 iPhone 的监控服务吗？

sentences.en: And I'm like, what do you mean?
sentences.zh: 我说，你是什么意思？

sentences.en: He's like, well, parental controls.
sentences.zh: 他说，嗯，家长控制。

sentences.en: You know, is there any way to put parental controls on an iPhone?
sentences.zh: 你知道，有什么办法可以在 iPhone 上设置家长控制吗？

sentences.en: And that's when Idhan explained to me that Britney's communication is monitored for her own, you know, security and protection.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，埃丹向我解释说，为了她自己的，你知道的，安全和保护，布兰妮的通讯受到了监控。

sentences.en: So Alex says that he, at first, asked, Britney's phone is monitored.
sentences.zh: 所以亚历克斯说他起初问，布兰妮的手机被监控了？

sentences.en: And Idhan told him, yes.
sentences.zh: 埃丹告诉他，是的。

sentences.en: You know, these are basically parental controls that you would have for your minor child.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这基本上就是你对未成年孩子会有的那种家长控制。

sentences.en: I asked Idhan about the legality of that, actually.
sentences.zh: 实际上我问过埃丹这是否合法。

sentences.en: Are you allowed to do that?
sentences.zh: 你们被允许这样做吗？

sentences.en: And he said, yes.
sentences.zh: 他说，是的。

sentences.en: The court is aware of this.
sentences.zh: 法院是知道这一点的。

sentences.en: Britney's lawyer is aware of this.
sentences.zh: 布兰妮的律师是知道这一点的。

sentences.en: This is for her safety.
sentences.zh: 这是为了她的安全。

sentences.en: It's for her protection.
sentences.zh: 这是为了保护她。

sentences.en: So they would give Britney an iPhone in which an iCloud account would be on that phone.
sentences.zh: 所以他们会给布兰妮一部手机，手机上会登录一个 iCloud 账户。

sentences.en: And they would then set up a mirrored iCloud account on an iPad that they had control of.
sentences.zh: 然后他们会在他们控制的一台 iPad 上设置一个镜像 iCloud 账户。

sentences.en: And that would then allow them to mirror everything going on on Britney's phone.
sentences.zh: 然后这将允许他们镜像布兰妮手机上发生的一切。

sentences.en: You know, all of her photos, all of her videos, all of her text messages, her browser history, her notes on this iPad that they could then monitor.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她所有的照片、所有的视频、所有的短信、她的浏览器历史记录、她在这台 iPad 上的笔记，他们都可以进行监控。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: But they would also monitor conversations with her friends, with her mom, with her lawyer, Sam Ingham.
sentences.zh: 但他们还会监控她与朋友、她妈妈、她的律师萨姆·英厄姆的对话。

sentences.en: If there's anybody that should be off-limits, it should be Britney's lawyer.
sentences.zh: 如果有谁应该是禁区，那应该是布兰妮的律师。

sentences.en: And, you know, I still felt that I'm not understanding something.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我仍然觉得我有什么地方没搞懂。

sentences.en: So I think that was very shocking to us because, you know, even if there may have been, and we don't know,
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得这对我们来说非常震惊，因为，你知道，即使可能存在，虽然我们不知道，

sentences.en: some court approval to make sure nothing bad was happening to Britney on her phone, it would be very shocking if that would apply to attorney-client privilege.
sentences.zh: 某些法院批准以确保布兰妮在手机上没有发生不好的事情，如果这适用于律师与客户的保密特权，那将是非常令人震惊的。

sentences.en: Working at Black Box, I saw so much.
sentences.zh: 在黑盒工作期间，我看到了太多东西。

sentences.en: I'm not a law expert, so I can't speak to the legality of everything.
sentences.zh: 我不是法律专家，所以我不能谈论每件事的合法性。

sentences.en: But ethically, it was just one big mess.
sentences.zh: 但在道德上，这简直是一团糟。

sentences.en: And that wasn't even the most shocking thing that Alex said.
sentences.zh: 而这甚至还不是亚历克斯说的最令人震惊的事情。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: Idhan had an audio recording device put into Britney's bedroom.
sentences.zh: 埃丹在布兰妮的卧室里装了一个录音设备。

sentences.en: So the other really shocking allegation that Alex made was that they had secretly recorded audio in Britney's bedroom.
sentences.zh: 所以亚历克斯爆出的另一个真正令人震惊的指控是，他们在布兰妮的卧室里秘密录制了音频。

sentences.en: Idhan and one of the agents working with him came into my office and handed me the audio recording device and a USB drive and asked me to wipe it.
sentences.zh: 埃丹和与他合作的一名特工走进我的办公室，把录音设备和一个U盘交给我，让我把它擦除。

sentences.en: But they seemed very nervous and said that it was extremely sensitive, that nobody can ever know about this,
sentences.zh: 但他们看起来非常紧张，并说这极其敏感，任何人都绝对不能知道这件事，

sentences.en: and that's why I need to delete everything on it so there's no record of it.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我需要删除里面的所有东西，这样就不会留下任何记录。

sentences.en: So Alex said, why?
sentences.zh: 所以亚历克斯问，为什么？

sentences.en: And they explained to him what it was and what they had done.
sentences.zh: 他们向他解释了那是什么以及他们做了什么。

sentences.en: And they said that no one could ever know about this.
sentences.zh: 他们说绝对不能让任何人知道这件事。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: I mean, that sounds incredibly terrifying.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，听起来太可怕了。

sentences.en: And I know that she's in this conservatorship, which gives her father a lot of rights over her life.
sentences.zh: 我知道她处于这种成年监护之下，这赋予了她父亲对她生活的很多权力。

sentences.en: But still, is that legal?
sentences.zh: 但即便如此，这合法吗？

sentences.en: So that's a big question.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个大问题。

sentences.en: Both mirroring text messages between two parties without consent and secretly recording people's conversations in a private place without their knowledge or consent could be a violation of the law.
sentences.zh: 未经同意镜像双方之间的短信，以及在私人场所未经知情或同意秘密记录人们的对话，都可能违反法律。

sentences.en: But what we don't know is whether the court was aware of or had approved any of this.
sentences.zh: 但我们不知道的是，法院是否知晓或批准了其中的任何事情。

sentences.en: We know that nothing publicly available in the conservatorship case appeared to give them the powers to do this.
sentences.zh: 我们知道，成年人监护案中公开的信息没有一条表明他们有权这样做。

sentences.en: But a lot of the court case is sealed.
sentences.zh: 但很大一部分法庭文件都被封存了。

sentences.en: So it's always possible there was some secret authority given at some point or authority was given in a very narrow circumstance.
sentences.zh: 所以，在某些时候可能确实赋予了某种秘密权力，或者在非常特殊的情况下授予了权力，这种可能性总是存在的。

sentences.en: And then it's also possible, no, they were just going rogue and this was nothing that the court had given authority over.
sentences.zh: 当然，还有另一种可能，那就是他们根本就是胡作非为，法庭压根没赋予他们这方面的权力。

sentences.en: And when we went for comment to Jamie Spears and the security company, specifically Jamie's response to us was that, you know,
sentences.zh: 当我们向杰米·斯皮尔斯和安保公司征求意见时，杰米具体对我们说的是，你知道的，

sentences.en: anything he did was within the authority that the court had given him and that they had the approval of either Brittany, her court-appointed lawyer, or the court.
sentences.zh: 他所做的一切都在法庭授予他的权力范围内，并且获得了布兰妮、她由法庭指派的律师或法庭的批准。

sentences.en: And how did Alex's time at Blackbox security end?
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯在黑盒安保公司的任职是如何结束的？

sentences.en: When I was leaving Blackbox, my filter went away.
sentences.zh: 当我离开黑盒时，我的顾忌也没了。

sentences.en: You know, I was very open about, I disagree how you run the business.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我非常坦诚，我不同意你经营公司的方式。

sentences.en: I disagree how you are ethically.
sentences.zh: 我不同意你的道德准则。

sentences.en: He's like, well, we should really talk about that.
sentences.zh: 他说，好吧，我们真得好好谈谈这个。

sentences.en: So over the years, Alex starts to get more and more uncomfortable with these red flags that he's noticing and what he views is crossing ethical lines.
sentences.zh: 因此，多年来，亚历克斯对所注意到的这些危险信号以及他认为越过道德底线的行为，开始感到越来越不安。

sentences.en: And this culminates in him becoming bolder and bolder with his comments to Adan about how he feels about things.
sentences.zh: 这最终导致他对阿丹的感受越来越直言不讳。

sentences.en: He calls me into his office and, you know, he takes the gun in his holster with his clip out, you know, puts it on the table and starts with,
sentences.zh: 他把我叫进办公室，然后，你知道，他把枪从枪套里拿出来，退了弹夹，放在桌子上，然后开口说，

sentences.en: so you don't like the way I run my business?
sentences.zh: 所以你对我经营公司的方式很不满？

sentences.en: I mean, it's not a threat, but it's a threat.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这算不上威胁，但这就是个威胁。

sentences.en: Adan denies that the incident happened, but I think for Alex, it was a big part of why he stayed silent for so long and why it was so difficult to go public with this information.
sentences.zh: 阿丹否认发生过这件事，但我认为对亚历克斯来说，这也是他保持沉默那么久、以及将这些信息公之于众为何如此艰难的重要原因。

sentences.en: He felt really intimidated by how much power Adan had in the industry and also just what he had seen him be capable of.
sentences.zh: 阿丹在业内拥有的权势以及他所见过的阿丹的能力，让他感到非常畏惧。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So that's sort of how Alex gets disillusioned with all of this.
sentences.zh: 所以，亚历克斯就是这样对这一切彻底幻灭的。

sentences.en: Do we know at the time how much Brittany is actually aware of or how she felt about basically being spied on by her father?
sentences.zh: 我们当时是否知道布兰妮对被父亲监视这件事到底了解多少，或者她对此作何感想？

sentences.en: So we don't really know.
sentences.zh: 所以我们其实并不清楚。

sentences.en: And, you know, when Brittany appears in public, she's smiling and performing in Vegas, making millions of dollars and selling perfume and the brand is great.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，当布兰妮公开露面时，她总是面带微笑，在拉斯维加斯表演，赚着数百万美元，卖着香水，品牌形象非常好。

sentences.en: And then we'd see her on Instagram posting inspirational memes or dancing.
sentences.zh: 然后我们会看到她在Instagram上发布励志表情包或者跳舞。

sentences.en: And, you know, she never really commented on the conservatorship or said anything public about it.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，她从来没有真正对监护权发表过意见，也没有公开说过任何相关的话。

sentences.en: And then in spring 2021, something really unusual happens.
sentences.zh: 然后，在2021年春天，一件非常不寻常的事发生了。

sentences.en: Brittany's court-appointed lawyer tells the judge that Brittany would like to address the court.
sentences.zh: 布兰妮由法庭指派的律师告诉法官，布兰妮希望向法庭陈述。

sentences.en: And so the judge sets the date for June 23rd, 2021, in which Brittany will speak to the court.
sentences.zh: 于是法官将日期定在2021年6月23日，届时布兰妮将向法庭发言。

sentences.en: And there's a real chance that she's going to talk publicly about her conservatorship for the first time.
sentences.zh: 而且她很有可能会第一次公开谈论自己的监护权问题。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费试用《纽约时报》一个月，甚至不需要提供信用卡，会怎么样？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看时报订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订阅者，今天就下载时报应用程序，免费畅享30天。

sentences.en: So, Liz, tell me about this moment in June when Brittany Spears finally broke her silence about her conservatorship.
sentences.zh: 那么，莉兹，跟我聊聊6月份布兰妮·斯皮尔斯终于打破沉默谈论其监护权的那个时刻吧。

sentences.en: So, June 23rd, 2021, hearing rolls around.
sentences.zh: 好的，2021年6月23日的听证会如期举行。

sentences.en: Brittany Spears.
sentences.zh: 布兰妮·斯皮尔斯。

sentences.en: And because of COVID, the court allows the public to listen in live to the hearing.
sentences.zh: 由于疫情原因，法院允许公众在线旁听听证会。

sentences.en: So, I was listening from my house, as were many, many people.
sentences.zh: 所以我和许多许多人一样，在家进行旁听。

sentences.en: And I was really nervous and excited to hear what Brittany was going to say.
sentences.zh: 听到布兰妮要说的话，我既紧张又兴奋。

sentences.en: I believe you're on the telephone.
sentences.zh: 我想你正在通电话。

sentences.en: Hi, good afternoon.
sentences.zh: 嗨，下午好。

sentences.en: Good afternoon.
sentences.zh: 下午好。

sentences.en: Thank you for coming in today.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你今天抽空前来。

sentences.en: And the court hearing starts, and the judge says, Brittany is ready to address the court.
sentences.zh: 听证会开始了，法官说，布兰妮准备好向法庭陈述了。

sentences.en: Ms. Spears, you know, I hear that you have something to say.
sentences.zh: 斯皮尔斯女士，我听说你有些话要说。

sentences.en: And Brittany says hello.
sentences.zh: 布兰妮说了声你好。

sentences.en: And then she launches into this very passionate, 20-minute-plus-long speech, breaking her silence in detail about how she feels about the conservatorship.
sentences.zh: 接着她发表了一场长达20多分钟、充满激情的演讲，打破沉默，详细讲述了她对监护权的感受。

sentences.en: And it was very much so not the public narrative that had been presented.
sentences.zh: 这与之前呈现给公众的说法大相径庭。

sentences.en: I'm not happy.
sentences.zh: 我不快乐。

sentences.en: I can't sleep.
sentences.zh: 我睡不着觉。

sentences.en: I'm so angry.
sentences.zh: 我很生气。

sentences.en: It's insane.
sentences.zh: 这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: And I'm depressed.
sentences.zh: 而且我很沮丧。

sentences.en: I cry every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都在哭。

sentences.en: And the reason I'm telling you this is because I don't think how the state of California can have all this written
sentences.zh: 我告诉你这些的原因是，我不明白加州政府怎么能把这一切写进法院文件中，

sentences.en: in the court documents from the time I showed up and do absolutely nothing.
sentences.zh: 从我出现开始就记录在案，却什么都不做。

sentences.en: Just hire with my money.
sentences.zh: 只管用我的钱去雇人。

sentences.en: She said that she felt the conservatorship had way too much control over her life and was really oppressive.
sentences.zh: 她说她觉得监护权对她生活的控制实在是太多了，简直令人窒息。

sentences.en: I've been in shock.
sentences.zh: 我一直在震惊中。

sentences.en: I am traumatized.
sentences.zh: 我受到了创伤。

sentences.en: You know, fake it till you make it.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，装到成功为止。

sentences.en: But now I'm telling you the truth, okay?
sentences.zh: 但现在我跟你说的是实话，好吗？

sentences.en: I'm not happy.
sentences.zh: 我不快乐。

sentences.en: She brings up the point that she has made millions of dollars for other people under this conservatorship.
sentences.zh: 她指出，在这个监护权下，她为其他人赚取了数百万美元。

sentences.en: I was basically directing most of the show, meaning I taught my dancers my new choreography myself.
sentences.zh: 基本上整个演出都是我在指导，意思是我自己把新编的舞蹈动作教给伴舞的。

sentences.en: I take everything I do very seriously.
sentences.zh: 我对自己的每一项工作都极其认真。

sentences.en: There's tons of video with me at rehearsals.
sentences.zh: 有大量我在排练现场的视频。

sentences.en: I wasn't good.
sentences.zh: 我不仅表现不错。

sentences.en: I was great.
sentences.zh: 我是极好的。

sentences.en: I led a room of 16 new dancers in rehearsals.
sentences.zh: 在排练中，我带领着一间有16位新伴舞的排练室。

sentences.en: I shouldn't be in a conservatorship if I can work and provide money and work for myself and pay other people.
sentences.zh: 如果我能工作、能赚钱、能为自己工作并支付别人的薪水，我就不应该被置于监护权之下。

sentences.en: It makes no sense.
sentences.zh: 这毫无道理。

sentences.en: Conservatorships are only supposed to be for people who can't, you know, feed, clothe, or shelter themselves.
sentences.zh: 监护权本来应该只适用于那些无法自己吃饭、穿衣或解决住所问题的人。

sentences.en: Yet Brittany has been able to make millions of dollars actively performing.
sentences.zh: 然而布兰妮却一直在积极进行商业演出并赚取数百万美元。

sentences.en: What state allows people to own another person's money and account and threaten them and saying,
sentences.zh: 究竟是哪个州允许别人拥有另一个人的金钱和账户，还威胁他们说，

sentences.en: you can't spend your money unless you do what we want you to do, and I'm paying them.
sentences.zh: 只要你不按我们的要求做，就别想花自己的钱，而且花得还是我赚的钱。

sentences.en: Ma'am, I've worked since I've been there.
sentences.zh: 女士，自从我来到那里我就一直在工作。

sentences.en: What else did she say?
sentences.zh: 她还说了什么？

sentences.en: I don't feel like I can live a full life.
sentences.zh: 我觉得自己无法过上完整的生活。

sentences.en: Well, she talked about how she couldn't drive alone with her boyfriend in her car under the conservatorship.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她谈到了在监护权下，她甚至不能和男友单独开车兜风。

sentences.en: And I'm not able to see my friends that live eight minutes away from me, which I find extremely strange.
sentences.zh: 而且我也不能去看望那些离我只有八分钟车程的朋友，我觉得这极其奇怪。

sentences.en: I feel like they're making me feel like I live in a rehab program.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他们让我感觉自己像是生活在戒毒所里。

sentences.en: This is my home.
sentences.zh: 这是我的家。

sentences.en: She also describes some very private ways in which she felt the conservatorship controlled her life.
sentences.zh: 她还描述了一些非常私密的细节，讲述监护权是如何控制她的生活的。

sentences.en: I want to be able to get married and have a baby.
sentences.zh: 我希望能结婚生子。

sentences.en: I was told right now in the conservatorship I'm not able to get married or have a baby.
sentences.zh: 但我被告知，在目前的监护权下，我不能结婚或生孩子。

sentences.en: I have an ID inside of myself right now, so I don't get pregnant.
sentences.zh: 我现在体内装着一个节育器，所以我不会怀孕。

sentences.en: I wanted to take the ID out so I could start trying to have another baby,
sentences.zh: 我想把节育器取出来，这样我就可以开始尝试再要一个孩子，

sentences.en: but this so-called team won't let me go to the doctor to take it out because they don't want me to have children, any more children.
sentences.zh: 但这个所谓的团队不让我去看医生把它取出来，因为他们不想让我再生孩子，不想让我有任何更多的孩子。

sentences.en: So basically, this conservatorship is doing me way more harm than good.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，这个监护权带给我的弊远大于利。

sentences.en: Brittany also mentioned that she wanted to have the right to pick her own lawyer.
sentences.zh: 布兰妮还提到，她希望能有权选择自己的律师。

sentences.en: And the lawyer she'd had for the past 13 years was not someone who she had chosen.
sentences.zh: 过去13年里一直陪伴她的律师并不是她自己挑选的。

sentences.en: It was someone who the court had appointed for her.
sentences.zh: 那是法庭为她指定的人。

sentences.en: But I haven't really had the opportunity by my own self to actually handpick my own lawyer by myself.
sentences.zh: 但我自己其实从来没有机会真正亲手挑选我自己的律师。

sentences.en: And I would like to be able to do that.
sentences.zh: 我希望能有这样的权利。

sentences.en: And she said she didn't just want her father removed as conservator.
sentences.zh: 而且她说，她不仅希望免除她父亲的监护人职务。

sentences.en: Ma'am, my dad and anyone involved in this conservatorship and my management who played a huge role in punishing me when I said, no, ma'am, they should be in jail.
sentences.zh: 女士，我父亲以及所有参与这个监护权项目的任何人，还有我的管理团队，当我说不的时候，他们在惩罚我这件事上扮演了巨大的角色，他们应该进监狱。

sentences.en: She wanted him in jail.
sentences.zh: 她想让父亲进监狱。

sentences.en: I deserve to have the same rights as anybody does by having a child, a family, any of those things, and more so.
sentences.zh: 我有资格拥有和任何人一样的权利，去拥有一个孩子、一个家庭，拥有所有这些，甚至更多。

sentences.en: And that's all I wanted to say to you.
sentences.zh: 这就是我想对您说的一切。

sentences.en: And thank you so much for letting me speak to you today.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢您今天让我发言。

sentences.en: So, after this hearing, where we finally hear how Brittany really feels about this conservatorship, what happens next?
sentences.zh: 那么，在这次听证会之后，当我们终于听到布兰妮对这个监护权的真实感受后，接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: So, you start to see major changes in the wake of Brittany speaking in June.
sentences.zh: 所以，在布兰妮6月份公开发言之后，你开始看到重大的变化。

sentences.en: There's changes to her security firm.
sentences.zh: 她的安保公司发生了变动。

sentences.en: You start seeing Brittany out and about more often, driving things that, you know, she said she hadn't been allowed to do.
sentences.zh: 你开始看到布兰妮更频繁地外出，做一些，你知道的，她曾说过以前不被允许做的事情。

sentences.en: But most notably, Brittany is able to hire her own lawyer for the first time.
sentences.zh: 但最引人注目的是，布兰妮生平第一次能够自己聘请律师了。

sentences.en: And this new lawyer is really aggressive towards removing Jamie.
sentences.zh: 这位新律师在试图罢免杰米方面表现得非常强势。

sentences.en: He files to remove Jamie almost immediately and says that he wants to depose him and do a full investigation into Jamie and the last 13 years of the conservatorship.
sentences.zh: 他几乎立即就提交了罢免杰米的申请，并表示要对杰米以及过去13年的监护权进行彻底调查和取证。

sentences.en: And did that actually produce any changes?
sentences.zh: 这真的带来什么改变了吗？

sentences.en: Yes, a lot of changes, very quickly.
sentences.zh: 是的，发生了很大变化，而且速度很快。

sentences.en: At first, Jamie continues to say, I'm not going to step down.
sentences.zh: 起初，杰米仍然坚持说，我不会辞职。

sentences.en: I've done nothing wrong.
sentences.zh: 我没有做错任何事。

sentences.en: Brittany's lawyer fights back and keeps going after him.
sentences.zh: 布兰妮的律师发起反击，紧追不舍。

sentences.en: And this culminates in this real curveball that Jamie files on September 7th, in which he asks the court to consider terminating the conservatorship completely and ending it.
sentences.zh: 这最终导致杰米在9月7日抛出一个真正的杀手锏，他请求法庭考虑彻底终止并结束监护权。

sentences.en: Wow, that is a curveball.
sentences.zh: 哇，这真是个大转折。

sentences.en: And what do you think explains that?
sentences.zh: 你认为这该如何解释？

sentences.en: So, we don't know, but in court filings, Brittany's lawyer said that Jamie was probably doing this because he feels backed into a corner and wants to avoid being investigated.
sentences.zh: 我们不得而知，但在法庭文件中，布兰妮的律师表示杰米这么做可能是因为他感到了走投无路，想要逃避调查。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So, where do things stand today?
sentences.zh: 那么，目前的局势如何？

sentences.en: So, today there's a big hearing and the court is expected to decide two big things.
sentences.zh: 今天有一场重大的听证会，法院预计将对两件大事做出裁决。

sentences.en: The first is Brittany's request to remove Jamie as conservator.
sentences.zh: 第一件是布兰妮要求罢免杰米监护人职务的请求。

sentences.en: And the second is Jamie's request for the judge to decide whether to terminate the conservatorship completely.
sentences.zh: 第二件是杰米请求法官决定是否彻底终止监护权。

sentences.en: And do we have any indication of how the judge might rule?
sentences.zh: 我们有任何迹象表明法官会如何裁决吗？

sentences.en: That's a great question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个好问题。

sentences.en: I mean, people think that there's a good chance that Jamie could be removed today.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，人们认为杰米今天被罢免的可能性很大。

sentences.en: But it's really unclear.
sentences.zh: 但这真的很不确定。

sentences.en: Brittany's lawyer has used this argument that he's not in Brittany's best intereSt.
sentences.zh: 布兰妮的律师一直使用“他并不符合布兰妮的最佳利益”这一论点。

sentences.en: And Jamie continues to maintain he's only ever acted in Brittany's best intereSt.
sentences.zh: 而杰米则一如既往地坚称，他所做的一切始终是为了布兰妮的最佳利益。

sentences.en: So, I know that a lot of the details of this story are truly specific to Brittany Spears.
sentences.zh: 所以，我知道这个故事的许多细节确实非常针对布兰妮·斯皮尔斯。

sentences.en: There just, like, aren't that many mega-celebrities who are in these kind of conservatorships.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，处于这种监护之下的超级巨星实在没那么多。

sentences.en: But there are a lot of other people in conservatorships.
sentences.zh: 但还有许多其他人也身处监护权之下。

sentences.en: Does what's happening in Brittany's case mean anything to those people?
sentences.zh: 布兰妮案中发生的事对那些人有什么意义吗？

sentences.en: Well, before Brittany's case, not a lot of people knew anything about conservatorships.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在布兰妮的案子之前，没多少人对监护权有所了解。

sentences.en: We don't even know how many of them there are in this country.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至不知道这个国家到底有多少个这样的监护案。

sentences.en: It's estimated over a million.
sentences.zh: 据估计超过一百万。

sentences.en: So, in a way, Brittany's case has really taught a lot of people about what conservatorships are
sentences.zh: 所以从某种程度上说，布兰妮的案子确实让很多人了解了什么是监护权，

sentences.en: and really shed light on the extraordinary amount of power that a conservator gets over a conservatee.
sentences.zh: 并且真正揭示了监护人对被监护人拥有何等惊人的权力。

sentences.en: And just as importantly, just how little oversight there can sometimes be once a conservatorship is established.
sentences.zh: 同样重要的是，一旦建立监护权，有时监管的缺失会达到何种令人发指的地步。

sentences.en: It's taken enormous amount of pressure and public attention for the courts to even seriously consider removing Jamie.
sentences.zh: 法院甚至要认真考虑罢免杰米，都需要付出巨大的压力和公众关注。

sentences.en: So, if all of this can happen to Brittany Spears, what does that mean for someone who doesn't have those resources or that fame?
sentences.zh: 因此，如果这一切都能发生在布兰妮·斯皮尔斯身上，那对那些没有这些资源或名气的人来说意味着什么？

sentences.en: Liz, how do you feel about this story after having spent so many years looking into Brittany and her conservatorship?
sentences.zh: 莉兹，花了这么多年调查布兰妮和她的监护权后，你对这个故事有什么感想？

sentences.en: Like, what is your takeaway from all this?
sentences.zh: 比如说，你从这一切中得到了什么启示？

sentences.en: I guess one takeaway I do have that I think about a lot is just how long this has gone on.
sentences.zh: 我想我所获得的一个并且经常思考的感悟就是，这件事竟然持续了这么久。

sentences.en: And it seems as if for a very long time, people were willing to buy into this narrative that doesn't make any sense,
sentences.zh: 而且似乎在很长一段时间里，人们都愿意相信这样一个毫无逻辑的说法，

sentences.en: which is that someone could fit this standard but also be able to perform and make millions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 那就是一个人既符合这种被监护的标准，却同时又能进行表演并赚取数百万美元。

sentences.en: Those two things cannot be true at the same time.
sentences.zh: 这两件事不可能同时成立。

sentences.en: But everyone was kind of willing to just believe it because you got to go to a good show
sentences.zh: 但大家都有点愿意去相信它，因为能看到一场精彩的演出

sentences.en: and see your favorite celebrity out there smiling and it was just much easier to believe that everything was okay.
sentences.zh: 看到你喜欢的名人面带微笑站在那儿，人们更容易相信一切都好。

sentences.en: And I think the public is a lot more sympathetic now or empathetic to putting themselves in her shoes and, you know, believing her and or just wanting to see her succeed.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，现在公众更加同情或感同身受，能够设身处地为她着想，你知道的，选择相信她，并且或者只是想看到她取得成功。

sentences.en: Why do you think that is?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这是为什么呢？

sentences.en: Like, why is the public more sympathetic now?
sentences.zh: 比如，为什么现在公众更有同情心了？

sentences.en: I think it was Brittany herself publicly speaking and kind of shattering the public narrative that all was well
sentences.zh: 我认为是布兰妮本人公开的发声，某种程度上打破了公众认为一切安好的叙事

sentences.en: and her dad had saved her life and everything was great under the conservatorship.
sentences.zh: 认为她爸爸拯救了她的生活，在监护权下一切都好。

sentences.en: And she spoke in such detail and so passionately and said so many shocking things.
sentences.zh: 而且她讲述得如此详细，充满激情，说出了那么多令人震惊的事情。

sentences.en: It really woke up a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 这确实唤醒了很多人。

sentences.en: I think it's sometimes easy to overlook the fact that there's a human being with rights and with dignity and with respect at the center of all of this.
sentences.zh: 我认为有时很容易忽视这样一个事实：在这一切的中心，有一个拥有权利、尊严和受到尊重的人。

sentences.en: And I think that gets lost in the spectacle and the legal jousting and the, you know, nuance of medical issues and just the nitty gritty of it all.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为这在这一场闹剧、法律博弈、你知道的，医疗问题的细微差别以及所有的核心细节中迷失了。

sentences.en: And I think it's just nice when that person is listened to.
sentences.zh: 我觉得能听到这个人的心声，真的很好。

sentences.en: Liz, thank you.
sentences.zh: 莉兹，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: It is imperative that Congress address the debt limit.
sentences.zh: 国会必须解决债务上限问题。

sentences.en: If not, our current estimate is that Treasury will likely exhaust its extraordinary measures by October 18th.
sentences.zh: 如果不能，我们目前的估计是，财政部很可能会在10月18日之前耗尽其非常规措施。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen told lawmakers that they have until October 18th to raise the federal debt limit
sentences.zh: 周二，财政部长珍妮特·耶伦对议员们表示，他们必须在10月18日之前提高联邦债务上限

sentences.en: or else risk running out of money to pay the nation's bills.
sentences.zh: 否则将面临无钱支付国家账单的风险。

sentences.en: At that point, we expect Treasury would be left with very limited resources that would be depleted quickly.
sentences.zh: 到那时，我们预计财政部将只剩下非常有限的资源，并且会很快耗尽。

sentences.en: America would default for the first time in history.
sentences.zh: 美国将出现历史上第一次债务违约。

sentences.en: She warned that if the debt limit isn't raised, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 她警告说，如果不提高债务上限，美国

sentences.en: could default on its debt, potentially triggering a financial crisis and an economic recession.
sentences.zh: 可能会发生债务违约，从而引发潜在的金融危机和经济衰退。

sentences.en: Senators, the debt ceiling has been raised or suspended 78 times since 1960, almost always on a bipartisan basis.
sentences.zh: 参议员们，自1960年以来，债务上限已经被提高或暂停了78次，几乎总是在两党合作的基础上进行的。

sentences.en: My hope is that we can work together to do so again and to build a stronger American economy for future generations.
sentences.zh: 我希望我们能再次携手合作，为子孙后代建立一个更强大的美国经济。

sentences.en: Democrats have been racing to extend the limit before the deadline,
sentences.zh: 民主党人一直在争分夺秒地在期限到来之前延长上限，

sentences.en: but Senate Republicans have blocked those attempts and are trying to force Democrats to raise the limit on their own.
sentences.zh: 但参议院共和党人阻止了这些尝试，并试图强迫民主党人自行提高上限。

sentences.en: My task at that time was to de-escalate.
sentences.zh: 我当时的任务是缓和局势。

sentences.en: My message again was consistent.
sentences.zh: 我的信息依然是一致的。

sentences.en: Stay calm, steady, and de-escalate.
sentences.zh: 保持冷静、沉着，缓和局势。

sentences.en: We are not going to attack you.
sentences.zh: 我们不会攻击你们。

sentences.en: General Mark Milley, the chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, told a Senate committee on Tuesday that there was nothing improper about his calls to Chinese military officials
sentences.zh: 参谋长联席会议主席马克·米利将军周二在参议院委员会上表示，他致电中国军方官员没有任何不当之处

sentences.en: during the chaotic final days of the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 是在特朗普政府混乱的最后几天里。

sentences.en: In the calls, which were reported in a recent book by Bob Woodward and Robert Costa,
sentences.zh: 在鲍勃·伍德沃德和罗伯特·科斯塔最近的一本书中报道的这些通话中，

sentences.en: General Milley reassured China that the United States had no plans to attack it.
sentences.zh: 米利将军向中国保证，美国没有计划对其发动攻击。

sentences.en: I know, I am certain, that President Trump did not intend to attack the Chinese.
sentences.zh: 我知道，我确信，特朗普总统并不打算攻击中国人。

sentences.en: And it is my directed responsibility, and it was my directed responsibility by the secretary, to convey that intent to the Chinese.
sentences.zh: 我有责任，而且是部长直接指示我的责任，向中方传达这一意图。

sentences.en: And finally, a vaccine mandate for New York State health care workers that went into effect this week
sentences.zh: 最后，本周生效的纽约州医护人员疫苗强制令

sentences.en: appears to have convinced thousands of unvaccinated health care workers to get their shots.
sentences.zh: 似乎已经说服了成千上万未接种疫苗的医护人员去接种疫苗。

sentences.en: The mandate, which was announced back in August by then-Governor Andrew Cuomo, required that all 650,000 of the state's hospital and nursing home employees
sentences.zh: 这项由时任州长安德鲁·库莫于8月宣布的强制令要求，该州所有65万名医院和疗养院员工

sentences.en: receive at least one dose of a COVID-19 vaccine by Monday, or risk losing their jobs.
sentences.zh: 必须在周一之前接种至少一剂新冠疫苗，否则将面临失业的风险。

sentences.en: Tuesday, after the mandate had gone into effect, more than 92% of the state's health care workers had received a shot,
sentences.zh: 周二，在强制令生效后，该州超过92%的医护人员已经接种了疫苗，

sentences.en: suggesting that President Biden's plans to mandate vaccines for health care workers nationwide is likely to have a similar effect.
sentences.zh: 这表明拜登总统在全国范围内强制医护人员接种疫苗的计划可能会产生类似的效果。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Eric Krupke, Robert Jimmison, and Sydney Harper, with help from Jessica Chung and Michael Simon-Johnson.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由埃里克·克鲁普克、罗伯特·吉米森和悉尼·哈珀制作，杰西卡·钟和迈克尔·西蒙-约翰逊提供协助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Mike Benoit and engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 本期节目由迈克·贝努瓦剪辑，克里斯·伍德混音。

sentences.en: Original music by Dan Powell and Marion Lozano.
sentences.zh: 原创音乐由丹·鲍威尔和马里昂·洛扎诺创作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由吉姆·布伦伯格和《Wonderly》的本·兰兹伯格创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Kevin Roos.
sentences.zh: 我是凯文·罗斯。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一个受到严密控制的机器一样运转。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了群自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱、有时又令人惊心动魄的争斗之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《都市》最新一期节目中，我和萨拉·科尼格将为你讲述人们试图保持影响力却在过程中失控的故事。

sentences.en: Metro, listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 收听《都市》，请在你获取播客的任何平台订阅。
